metadata.name: SVGCraft Studio - Instant SVG Path Optimizer & Icon Code Exporter
metadata.target_audience: Frontend Developers, UI/UX Designers, Web Creators
metadata.core_problem: Raw SVG files from Figma/Illustrator are bloated with editor metadata, oversized path decimals, and non-standard attributes that slow page load.
metadata.solution: High-speed client-side SVG optimizer, path precision minifier, and one-click clean React/Vue/HTML component code exporter with zero dependencies.

monetization.free_tier: Unlimited single SVG optimization, minification, and code copy.
monetization.pro_tier: $14 one-time for Batch Sprite Sheet Compiler, 500+ Curated UI Icon Vector Pack & Commercial Embed License.

metadata.hosting_stack: 100% Client-side HTML5/Vanilla JS on GitHub Pages (Sub-30ms cold start, $0 overhead).
